title: Bottom layer value criterion
statement: Let $n,r,q$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and choose an index $i$ in a set of size $r^q2^r$. Use the specified bijection to write $i$ as a pair consisting of a group index $g<r^q$ and a sign assignment $a\in\{-1,1\}^r$. The corresponding bottom layer value is $-1$ if and only if the assignment obtained from $a$ by replacing entries beyond the input length with $1$ equals the block of $r$ input values starting at position $g$, with out-of-range input values padded by $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$i$ is an index in a set of size $r^q2^r$
